description: This file contains a shell script designed to validate WAN IPv4 and IPv6 connectivity by executing ping commands to public DNS servers, parsing the output to measure packet loss and latency, and verifying network reachability conditions. It includes commands, prerequisites, and notes for performing connectivity checks with detailed output normalization.

methods.name: Create R alias
methods.description: Defines a remote execution alias for ping commands, using the environment variable CRAM_REMOTE_COMMAND.
